test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In how much time will a sum of money double itself at 10 per cent per annum rate of simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Amount = 2x sum of money
 
• Rate = 10% per annum

**Formula used:**

**Simple\:interest(SI)={money(P)times Time(T)times Rate(R)over 100}**

**Calculation:**

Let sum of money be P = 100 rs.

Rate per annum = 10%

Amount = 2 x P= 2 x 100 = 200

=> Time(T)= {100times SIover Ptimes R}

=> Time(T)= {100times 100over 100times 10}

=> Time(T) = 10 years

**Hence, in '10' years will a sum of money double itself at a 10 percent per annum rate of simple interest.**
